content.title: A Financial Engineering Framework for Cryptocurrency Portfolio Optimization Based on a Four-Stage Intelligent Decision-Making
content.abstract: This paper presents a four-stage intelligent decision-making framework for cryptocurrency portfolio optimization. In the first stage, statistical anomalies are removed via Isolation Forest algorithm. The second stage establishes the statistical foundations of proposed approach, including exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA), covariance matrix using Ledoit–Wolf shrinkage, and higher-order moments (skewness and kurtosis).
